# The Lantern Ledger

## Opening the books

The harbour kept its accounts in a ledger of lanterns[1], one for each ship.

\# Not a heading, and a line\
broken by hand.

This page is page 1 of the ledger.

#### Closing

The ledger closed at dusk[2] with a café toast.

## Notes

[1] Every lantern had a number.

[2] Dusk was at six.
